RoPS played in the Finnish Premier Division, (''[[Veikkausliiga]]'') for 32 years, from 1981 to 2021. In 2021, RoPS withdrew from professional football and voluntarily relegated to the amateur ''[[Kakkonen]]'' division. The club plays home games at the Rovaniemen [[Keskuskenttä]] in the [[Arctic Circle]] of [[Lapland (Finland)|Lapland]]."}}
